[package]
name = "zero2prod"
edition = "2024"
version = "0.0.1"

[dependencies]
actix-web = "4.15.0"
chrono = "0.4.45"
config = "0.15.25"
log = "0.4.34"
tracing-actix-web = "0.7.22"
tracing-bunyan-formatter = "0.3.10"
tracing-log = "0.2.0"

[dependencies.secrecy]
version = "0.10.3"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.229"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.sqlx]
version = "0.9.0"
features = ["tls-rustls", "runtime-tokio", "macros", "postgres", "uuid", "chrono", "migrate"]
default-features = false

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.53.1"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1.44"
features = ["log"]

[dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3.23"
features = ["registry", "env-filter"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1.26.0"
features = ["v4"]

[dev-dependencies]
once_cell = "1.21.4"
reqwest = "0.13.4"

[[bin]]
path = "src/main.rs"
name = "zero2prod"
edition = "2024"
required-features = []

[[test]]
path = "tests/heath_check_test.rs"
name = "heath_check_test"
edition = "2024"
required-features = []

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"
name = "zero2prod"
edition = "2024"
required-features = []
crate-type = ["lib"]
